artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan implementing the widen-the-reader remedy with an additive implicit-open tally, null's meaning documented in both contracts, a new regression case, and a scratch-root fixture proof over the real 739/740 entries.

memory_candidates.content: A test suite that resolves its script-under-test deployed-copy-first (e.g. $REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/X.sh ahead of a source-store fallback) silently exercises STALE code when run after a source-store edit but before a redeploy, and reports a false green. In a deploy-artifact architecture (source store under agent-system/extensions/** regenerating a disposable .claude/** tree), any plan that edits a script in the source store must therefore order deploy BEFORE any suite run, and must not justify a pre-deploy phase's verification tier on suite coverage. The honest pre-deploy covering checks are lint (lint-shellcheck.sh) and a syntax/parse check (bash -n, or a jq -n parse of an embedded jq program).
